bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹测试 10 日和 200 日均线

read.en: Bloom Energy rose 7.1% on Oct 27 to $218.50, trading between $211.29 and $224.16. It is above the falling 5-day ($214.4) and just below the rising 200-day ($220.1) and falling 10-day ($221.8), with the falling 30-day ($258.8) and 100-day ($246.8) higher still. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($232.80), and RSI is 42.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 10月27日上涨 7.1%，收于 $218.50，盘中区间 $211.29–224.16。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$214.4）上方，略低于上行的 200 日均线（$220.1）和下行的 10 日均线（$221.8），下行的 30 日（$258.8）和 100 日均线（$246.8）更高。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$232.80），RSI 为 42。

read.en: The close cleared $210.7–213.1 (Oct 22 and 20 lows) and the 5-day, now support; the $224.2 high faded below the close at the 200 and 10-day. Resistance is $220.1–221.8, then $224.2 (Oct 27 high) and $232.8 (SAR). Support is $211.3–214.4 (Oct 27 low, 5-day), then $197.5 (Sep 1 low) and $189–192.2. A close above $221.8 would target $224–233; below $211, $197.5.

s.en: 5-day average $214.4; Oct 27 low $211.3; Oct 20 and Oct 22 lows ($210.7–213.1), cleared
